vb_textbox.text: The best and most productive gnomes in the game are the purple and red ones,Try to select them when given the choice, you will never be asked to pick between the 2Both purple and red gnomes start dropping off after selecting them many times, so when they are only producing 3 and below mushrooms, try the alternative gnome which gives better results.  The red and the purple will start picking up again after a few times of non selection, so when you see the mushroom count starting to rise again, keep selecting them until they start to drop off again and follow the same pattern
